sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipe1 YUVConv red coefficient register 1 (DCMIPP_P1YUVRR1)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.79 "DCMIPP Pipe1 YUVConv red coefficient register 1 (DCMIPP_P1YUVRR1)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1955.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x984
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Coefficients of the ColorConv, in signed 2.8 format (1.0 is coded by 0x100):
int_value = int(float_value * (1« 8) + 0.5)
Bits 31:27 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 26:16 RG[10:0]: Coefficient row 1 column 2 of the matrix
Bits 15:11 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 10:0 RR[10:0]: Coefficient row 1 column 1 of the matrix
